sentences.en: Thank you so much. To the graduates of the class of 2026 My congratulations to you all But also, my sympathies to you all.
sentences.zh: 太感谢了。致 2026 届毕业生，我向你们所有人表示祝贺，同时也向你们所有人表示同情。

sentences.en: You are coming of age in a complex era of rapid change.
sentences.zh: 你们正处于一个快速变化的复杂时代。

sentences.en: It feels hard to predict the near-term future and hard to make long-term decisions.
sentences.zh: 感觉很难预测近期的未来，也很难做出长期的决定。

sentences.en: There is a story of a famous statistician who was struggling to make an important life decision about whether he should stay on the east coast or move to the west coast.
sentences.zh: 有一个关于一位著名统计学家的故事，他正在努力做出一个重要的人生决定，即他应该留在东海岸还是搬到西海岸。

sentences.en: A colleague said to him: "You're an expert in statistics.
sentences.zh: 一位同事对他说：“你是统计学专家。

sentences.en: You know that the best way to make a decision is to write down all of the possible outcomes with their probabilities, and find the decision that maximizes the expected utility."
sentences.zh: 你知道，做出决定的最好方法就是写下所有可能的结果及其概率，并找到使预期效用最大化的决定。”

sentences.en: The statistician looked at the colleague with disbelief and responded: "You don't understand. This is real life."
sentences.zh: 统计学家难以置信地看着这位同事，回答道：“你不明白，这就是现实生活。”

sentences.en: Our difficulty in dealing with uncertainty is mitigated in part by the fact that we are part of communities, which can help us with long-term decisions.
sentences.zh: 我们是社区的一部分，这在一定程度上缓解了我们处理不确定性的困难，这可以帮助我们做出长期决策。

sentences.en: You are part of a community called CDSS.
sentences.zh: 您是 CDSS 社区的一员。

sentences.en: Commencements are moments in which we feel part of our community.
sentences.zh: 毕业典礼是我们感受到自己是社区一部分的时刻。

sentences.en: At my own commencement, far away, in the midst of time, sitting in my cap and gown, I found myself next to someone, who I hadn't met during my four years at the university.
sentences.zh: 在我自己的毕业典礼上，在遥远的时间里，我戴着帽子，穿着礼服，坐在一个人旁边，而我在大学四年里从未见过他。

sentences.en: Somehow, it felt that something should be said, and small talk seemed misplaced, so we just started talking, as if we'd had a long friendship.
sentences.zh: 不知怎的，总觉得有话要说，闲聊又显得不合时宜，所以我们就开始聊天，就好像我们已经有很长的友谊一样。

sentences.en: We kept talking during the very boring commencement speech.
sentences.zh: 在非常无聊的毕业典礼演讲中我们一直在说话。

sentences.en: We talked about our hopes, fears, experiences, and our families.
sentences.zh: 我们谈论了我们的希望、恐惧、经历和我们的家庭。

sentences.en: We then went our separate ways, with none of the sadness that usually accompanies a separation.
sentences.zh: 然后我们就分道扬镳了，没有任何分离带来的悲伤。

sentences.en: I can still remember the sensation of how unexpectedly deep a human connection could be, if the context is right.
sentences.zh: 我仍然记得如果上下文正确的话，人与人之间的联系可能会出人意料地深厚。

sentences.en: The theme of my remarks is going to be human connection in the era of internet technology.
sentences.zh: 我演讲的主题是互联网技术时代的人与人之间的联系。

sentences.en: Let me first briefly mention my credentials for tackling such a subject.
sentences.zh: 首先让我简要提及我处理这一主题的资历。

sentences.en: First, in addition to being a data scientist, I'm also a musician, with a deep respect for human artistic creativity.
sentences.zh: 首先，我除了是一名数据科学家之外，还是一名音乐家，对人类的艺术创造力怀有深深的尊重。

sentences.en: And I'm multilingual with a deep awareness of the need for human connectivity.
sentences.zh: 我会说多种语言，深刻认识到人际交往的必要性。

sentences.en: Lastly, I have children, and I know very well what it's like to worry about the future.
sentences.zh: 最后，我还有孩子，我很清楚为未来担心是什么感觉。

sentences.en: On that note, let me first address the parents.
sentences.zh: 关于这一点，让我首先向家长们讲话。

sentences.en: You may have been wondering over the past four years what data science is, or computer science, or statistics.
sentences.zh: 在过去的四年里，您可能一直想知道什么是数据科学、计算机科学或统计学。

sentences.en: Suffice it to say, they are all concerned with the use of data to inform decisions in areas of science, commerce, health care, and civil society.
sentences.zh: 可以说，他们都关心如何使用数据来为科学、商业、医疗保健和公民社会领域的决策提供信息。

sentences.en: Of course, the phrase artificial intelligence or AI is also being used these days to refer to this activity.
sentences.zh: 当然，人工智能或AI这个词现在也被用来指代这种活动。

sentences.en: I'm going to let you in on a little secret.
sentences.zh: 我要告诉你一个小秘密。

sentences.en: There's no clear distinction between data science and AI.
sentences.zh: 数据科学和人工智能之间没有明显的区别。

sentences.en: Indeed, the way I think about it, AI is just data science, with an overabundance of rather clueless type A personalities in charge.
sentences.zh: 事实上，在我看来，人工智能只是数据科学，由大量毫无头绪的 A 型人物负责。

sentences.en: Yes, graduates, I hereby license you to refer to yourselves as AI researchers, if and when that phrase is useful to you, for example, in your salary negotiations.
sentences.zh: 是的，毕业生们，如果这个短语对你们有用，例如在薪资谈判中，我特此允许你们称自己为人工智能研究人员。

sentences.en: OK, really do have to talk about AI. All of us are being affected by AI, and our progeny will be even more affected by AI.
sentences.zh: 好吧，确实得谈谈人工智能。我们所有人都在受到人工智能的影响，我们的子孙后代将受到人工智能的影响更大。

sentences.en: We need some clarity about what it is, what it might be, and how all of us can help shape its further development in positive ways.
sentences.zh: 我们需要弄清楚它是什么、可能是什么，以及我们所有人如何以积极的方式帮助塑造它的进一步发展。

sentences.en: In discussing AI, highly exaggerated language has become common, with some arguing that AI will usher in an age of plenty, and resolve our thorniest problems.
sentences.zh: 在讨论人工智能时，高度夸张的语言已经很常见，一些人认为人工智能将迎来一个富足的时代，并解决我们最棘手的问题。

sentences.en: And others arguing that it may enslave or destroy the human species.
sentences.zh: 其他人则认为它可能会奴役或毁灭人类。

sentences.en: Listening to all of this, it's easy to get confused.
sentences.zh: 听完所有这些，很容易感到困惑。

sentences.en: The usual way to talk about AI technology is to, first, overview some of the amazing recent developments that seem like science fiction, and then turn to the concerns.
sentences.zh: 谈论人工智能技术的通常方式是，首先概述一些看似科幻小说的令人惊叹的最新发展，然后转向人们的担忧。

sentences.en: At this point in time, however, I think it's helpful to invert the order and start with the concerns.
sentences.zh: 然而，在这个时候，我认为倒转顺序并从关注点开始是有帮助的。

sentences.en: So let's be clear at the outset, that there are some major challenges that the new technology is engendering.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们首先要明确的是，新技术带来了一些重大挑战。

sentences.en: First, it is clear there are going to be many kinds of job categories that are either going to disappear over the next decade or be transformed in ways that are hard to predict.
sentences.zh: 首先，很明显，有多种工作类别要么在未来十年内消失，要么以难以预测的方式发生转变。

sentences.en: This includes the job of computer programmer, which is amazing, because a decade ago, many of us viewed it as the safest job.
sentences.zh: 这包括计算机程序员的工作，这是令人惊奇的，因为十年前，我们许多人认为这是最安全的工作。

sentences.en: Second, education is going to need a thoroughgoing overhaul.
sentences.zh: 其次，教育需要彻底改革。

sentences.en: As recent graduates, that's, perhaps, alarming, but hopefully, you've understood by now that education is not a once and done kind of thing.
sentences.zh: 作为应届毕业生，这或许令人担忧，但希望您现在已经明白，教育不是一劳永逸的事情。

sentences.en: Third, inequality is going to be a consequence of the early years of this technology.
sentences.zh: 第三，不平等将是这项技术早年产生的结果。

sentences.en: There will be wealth inequality, even beyond what we see now, and there will be inequality of opportunity.
sentences.zh: 将会出现财富不平等，甚至超出我们现在所看到的程度，并且将会出现机会不平等。

sentences.en: It will be very tricky to navigate between allowing this to play out and let market forces mitigate it, versus aiming to stamp it out.
sentences.zh: 在允许这种情况发生并让市场力量缓解它与旨在消除它之间进行选择将是非常棘手的。

sentences.en: Fourth, the proliferation of fake AI-generated text and images is currently disrupting our society.
sentences.zh: 第四，人工智能生成的虚假文本和图像的泛滥目前正在扰乱我们的社会。

sentences.en: That will continue. Finally, the health and even the existence of democracies around the world will be challenged by all these issues.
sentences.zh: 这将继续下去。最后，世界各地民主国家的健康乃至生存都将受到所有这些问题的挑战。

sentences.en: Anti-democratic movements will feed on labor market upheaval inequality, and misinformation.
sentences.zh: 反民主运动将助长劳动力市场动荡、不平等和错误信息。

sentences.en: Faced with this uncomfortable list of facts, a natural reaction is, let's slow all of this down.
sentences.zh: 面对这一系列令人不安的事实，一个自然的反应是，让我们放慢这一切。

sentences.en: And why do we have to have so much technology anyway?
sentences.zh: 为什么我们必须拥有这么多技术？

sentences.en: I grew up in the 1960s and such reactions come very naturally to me.
sentences.zh: 我在 20 世纪 60 年代长大，这种反应对我来说很自然。

sentences.en: But I'm going to argue that we need ongoing technological progress, that it is elitist to argue otherwise, and that it need not undermine the things that make humans human
sentences.zh: 但我要说的是，我们需要不断的技术进步，否则的话就是精英主义，而且它不需要破坏人类的本质

sentences.en: -- a tall order for the next seven minutes.
sentences.zh: ——接下来的七分钟是一项艰巨的任务。

sentences.en: Let's start with a positive example of AI progress, one that could be viewed as mundane, given promises of curing cancer, but is nonetheless striking.
sentences.zh: 让我们从人工智能进步的一个积极例子开始，考虑到治愈癌症的承诺，这个例子可能被视为平凡，但仍然引人注目。

sentences.en: Let's say you've written something, and you're seeking feedback on what you've written.
sentences.zh: 假设您写了一些东西，并且正在寻求对您所写内容的反馈。

sentences.en: Friends and family are not very good sources of such feedback, as you will know, if you've ever told a friend, that his or her novel isn't very good -- oops, ex-friend.
sentences.zh: 朋友和家人并不是此类反馈的良好来源，如果您曾经告诉过朋友，您就会知道他或她的小说不太好 - 哎呀，前朋友。

sentences.en: Recently, I input a piece that I'd written into ChatGPT to ask for feedback.
sentences.zh: 最近，我将自己写的一篇文章输入ChatGPT以寻求反馈。

sentences.en: The feedback was superb, careful, interesting feedback down at the level of the paragraph, suggestions for how to make things clearer, suggestions of what else I could say.
sentences.zh: 段落层面的反馈非常好、仔细、有趣，提出了如何使事情变得更清晰的建议，以及我还能说些什么的建议。

sentences.en: I've never had such good feedback in all my years at the university as a student or as a professor.
sentences.zh: 在我作为学生或教授的大学生涯中，我从未得到过如此好的反馈。

sentences.en: Surely, this development is good for the species.
sentences.zh: 当然，这种发展对该物种有利。

sentences.en: It will provide this capability all around the world right now.
sentences.zh: 它将立即在世界各地提供这种能力。

sentences.en: It will create challenges, in particular our educational system.
sentences.zh: 它将带来挑战，特别是我们的教育体系。

sentences.en: The job of essay grader will be endangered.
sentences.zh: 论文评分员的工作将受到威胁。

sentences.en: Similarly, many secretarial jobs and management seem endangered, as are the consulting jobs that used to be the goal of so many undergraduates and so on.
sentences.zh: 同样，许多秘书工作和管理工作似乎也面临危险，曾经是许多本科生目标的咨询工作等也面临危险。

sentences.en: The question I want to focus on now is, where does it stop?
sentences.zh: 我现在要关注的问题是，它停在哪里？

sentences.en: Are there some things that the AI systems can't do?
sentences.zh: 是否有一些事情是人工智能系统无法做到的？

sentences.en: And what is the concrete economic relevance of this distinction?
sentences.zh: 这种区别的具体经济意义是什么？

sentences.en: One way to think about this is to investigate cases where the AI evangelists seem to be over extrapolating.
sentences.zh: 思考这个问题的一种方法是调查人工智能传播者似乎过度推断的案例。

sentences.en: Here's an example. Loneliness is an increasing problem in modern society.
sentences.zh: 这是一个例子。孤独是现代社会日益严重的问题。

sentences.en: It has been argued that chatbots can solve this problem.
sentences.zh: 有人认为聊天机器人可以解决这个问题。

sentences.en: Yes, some people enjoy dialogues with chatbots, and chatbots can mitigate the loneliness problem.
sentences.zh: 是的，有些人喜欢与聊天机器人对话，而聊天机器人可以缓解孤独感问题。

sentences.en: But the idea that chatbots can entirely replace humans is a mirage and even dangerous.
sentences.zh: 但聊天机器人可以完全取代人类的想法是海市蜃楼，甚至是危险的。

sentences.en: When a human wants a real connection, they need something other than fluent text.
sentences.zh: 当人们想要建立真正的联系时，他们需要的不仅仅是流畅的文本。

sentences.en: For example, consider the notion of vulnerability.
sentences.zh: 例如，考虑脆弱性的概念。

sentences.en: A real human connection is often based on a mutual sense of vulnerability.
sentences.zh: 真正的人际关系往往建立在相互的脆弱感之上。

sentences.en: Can you imagine applying the word vulnerable to ChatGPT?
sentences.zh: 您能想象应用“易受 ChatGPT 攻击”这个词吗？

sentences.en: What would it mean to hurt ChatGPT's feelings?
sentences.zh: 伤害ChatgPT的感觉意味着什么?

sentences.en: How might apologizing for hurting ChatGPT advance the relationship?
sentences.zh: 如何为伤害ChatGPT道歉 推进关系?

sentences.en: Some of our deepest emotions arise from having had a lifetime's experience, with its accumulation of little successes and little failures, its repository of great moments and great pains.
sentences.zh: 我们的一些最深切的情感产生于我们一生的经历,它积累了很少的成功和很少的失败,它蕴藏着伟大的时刻和巨大的痛苦。

sentences.en: Interacting with a human opens up the possibility of sharing such trajectories.
sentences.zh: 与人进行互动为分享这种轨迹开辟了可能性。

sentences.en: This happens, not only in one on one conversations, but also when we make connections with musicians, novelists, and other human artists.
sentences.zh: 不仅在一次对话中发生,而且当我们与音乐家、小说家和其他人类艺术家建立联系时也发生这种情况。

sentences.en: Generative AI systems are currently writing music and writing novels.
sentences.zh: 创作的人工智能系统目前正在撰写音乐和小说。

sentences.en: Will this work be listenable or readable?
sentences.zh: 这项工作是可倾听的还是可读的?

sentences.en: Probably. But don't tell me that generative AI will autonomously produce work that deeply connects with me.
sentences.zh: 可能吧,但别告诉我传说中的人工智能 将自主地产生与我紧密相连的工作

sentences.en: Generative AI doesn't have a lived life.
sentences.zh: 创世的人工智能没有生命

sentences.en: It can fake a lived life, but who wants a fake companion with a faked life?
sentences.zh: 它可以假冒生活, 但谁想要一个假伴侣 与假生活?

sentences.en: To summarize, I believe there will continue to be jobs in which the possibility of deep human to human connection is a critical part of the job.
sentences.zh: 概括地说,我相信将继续有工作,其中人与人之间深层联系的可能性是工作的一个关键部分。

sentences.en: And there will be new such jobs. These will not be going away.
sentences.zh: 还会有新的工作 这些不会消失的

sentences.en: There'll be even more of them in the future.
sentences.zh: 将来会有更多的人

sentences.en: Humans need other humans. To take this line of thought a little bit further and make it yet more scientific, it's important to understand that even though AI chatbots seem like a person,
sentences.zh: 人类需要其他人类。要让这种思想更进一步,使它更具科学性, 重要的是要理解,即使AI聊天机器人 看起来像一个人,

sentences.en: and indeed an extremely knowledgeable person, that's in part an illusion.
sentences.zh: 事实上,一个知识渊博的人, 这部分是幻觉。

sentences.en: If I ask a question to ChatGPT about general relativity, I'll get back a great answer.
sentences.zh: 如果我问ChatgPT 关于一般相对论的问题 我会得到一个很好的答案

sentences.en: That answer, though, is originating from people who've been writing about relativity on the internet.
sentences.zh: 答案来自那些在互联网上写相对论的人。

sentences.en: If I ask about intriguing new restaurants in Buenos Aires, I'm also going to get a great answer.
sentences.zh: 如果我问到在布宜诺斯艾利斯新餐馆的有趣之处, 我也会得到一个很好的答案。

sentences.en: It will be coming from another set of humans.
sentences.zh: 它会来自另一组人类

sentences.en: I can ask billions of questions, and what's happening is I'm being connected to billions of subsets of humans.
sentences.zh: 我可以问数十亿个问题, 和现在发生的事情是,我被连接到 数十亿个人类子集。

sentences.en: So instead of thinking of ChatGPT as a person, think of it as a window onto a culture.
sentences.zh: 所以不要把ChatGPT当成一个人 把它当作文化的窗口

sentences.en: Cultures are repositories of narratives, opinions, and abstractions.
sentences.zh: 文化是叙述、意见和抽象思想的宝库。

sentences.en: Cultures have personalities. So even chatbots can be thought of as ways to connect humans with humans.
sentences.zh: 文化有个性。甚至可以把聊天的机器人 视为连接人类的方法。

sentences.en: Let's take that point still further. Human connections aren't just about warm and fuzzy feelings.
sentences.zh: 更进一步说 人际关系不只是温暖和模糊的感觉

sentences.en: They also involve economic value. Many interactions involve people who have skills, ideas, and creative works to offer, and they want to team up with other people so that they can build things together that neither could do individually.
sentences.zh: 它们也涉及到经济价值。 许多互动都涉及那些拥有技能、思想和创造性作品的人,他们希望与其他人合作,以便他们能够共同构建既无法单独完成的事物。

sentences.en: This phenomenon is known as a market. Markets have been around for thousands of years, and they are responsible for the lion's share of our prosperity.
sentences.zh: 这种现象称为市场。市场已经存在了数千年，它为我们的繁荣做出了很大贡献。

sentences.en: Moreover, markets can be intelligent in ways that individuals aren't, just as ant colonies can do things that individual ants can't.
sentences.zh: 此外，市场的智能程度是个体所不具备的，就像蚁群可以做个体蚂蚁做不到的事情一样。

sentences.en: New kinds of intelligent markets can and should arise in the AI era, creating new kinds of jobs. We need to work on that.
sentences.zh: 人工智能时代可以而且应该出现新型智能市场，创造新的就业机会。我们需要为此努力。

sentences.en: As an example, while at Berkeley, I've been involved in a company that has been a disruptive force in the music industry.
sentences.zh: 举个例子，在伯克利期间，我参与了一家在音乐行业具有颠覆性力量的公司。

sentences.en: It has built a three-way market, linking musicians, listeners, and brands.
sentences.zh: 它建立了一个三向市场，将音乐家、听众和品牌联系起来。

sentences.en: Data science is used to make intelligent choices of songs for brands based on the demographics of listeners and the needs of brands.
sentences.zh: 数据科学用于根据听众的人口统计数据和品牌的需求为品牌明智地选择歌曲。

sentences.en: When a song gets played, for example, when the NBA uses a song in a video clip, the musician behind the song gets paid directly.
sentences.zh: 当一首歌曲被播放时，例如，当 NBA 在视频剪辑中使用一首歌曲时，歌曲背后的音乐家会直接获得报酬。

sentences.en: This is an example of an AI-based market that is actually creating jobs.
sentences.zh: 这是一个基于人工智能的市场实际上正在创造就业机会的例子。

sentences.en: And I hope that if you're entrepreneurially-minded, you'll think of other such companies that you might create, that create jobs of that kind, where human-human connections are the key.
sentences.zh: 我希望，如果你有创业精神，你会想到你可能创建的其他此类公司，这些公司会创造此类就业机会，其中人与人的联系是关键。

sentences.en: As a next step in making the data science program at Berkeley still more impactful and still more likely to produce graduates, who will create companies that link humans in productive ways, I believe that the field of economics should be brought in as a core partner.
sentences.zh: 为了使伯克利的数据科学项目更具影响力，更有可能培养出毕业生，他们将创建以富有成效的方式将人类联系起来的公司，下一步，我认为应该引入经济学领域作为核心合作伙伴。

sentences.en: Graduates should learn about markets. They should learn about the difference between equilibria and optima, and learn about how market equilibria can create social welfare.
sentences.zh: 毕业生应该了解市场。他们应该了解均衡和最优之间的区别，并了解市场均衡如何创造社会福利。

sentences.en: They should learn about market pathologies and learn about effective ways to regulate markets for the common good.
sentences.zh: 他们应该了解市场病态，并了解为了共同利益而监管市场的有效方法。

sentences.en: They should also learn to resist the knee jerk dismissiveness of markets and economics that one all too often encounters in academia.
sentences.zh: 他们还应该学会抵制学术界经常遇到的对市场和经济学的下意识的轻蔑态度。

sentences.en: Finally, let's return to whether we should keep our feet on the accelerator in data science and AI or whether we should slow down.
sentences.zh: 最后，让我们回到数据科学和人工智能的加速器上，还是应该放慢脚步。

sentences.en: I believe that we need to keep moving. The reason is simple, but nontrivial.
sentences.zh: 我相信我们需要继续前进。原因很简单，但并不平凡。

sentences.en: We are over 8 billion people on this planet.
sentences.zh: 这个星球上有超过 80 亿人口。

sentences.en: If there were a few thousand of us, then hunter-gatherer technology would do just fine, but we're not.
sentences.zh: 如果我们有几千人，那么狩猎采集技术就可以了，但我们不是。

sentences.en: And at the vast scale of the species, we need new technology and new kinds of markets to help us survive and thrive.
sentences.zh: 对于如此庞大的物种，我们需要新技术和新市场来帮助我们生存和繁荣。

sentences.en: It is elitism to assert that things are good enough as it is.
sentences.zh: 断言事情本来就足够好了，这是精英主义。

sentences.en: So, graduates, it's your turn. You are entering a complex world.
sentences.zh: 所以，毕业生们，轮到你们了。你正在进入一个复杂的世界。

sentences.en: While it will be impossible to avoid being confused and even fearful at times, here are a few things that may help.
sentences.zh: 虽然有时不可避免地会感到困惑甚至恐惧，但以下几点可能会有所帮助。

sentences.en: First, take a deep breath. This era isn't like a gold rush, where you need to grab opportunities quickly, or they'll disappear.
sentences.zh: 首先，深呼吸。这个时代不像淘金热，你需要迅速抓住机会，否则机会就会消失。

sentences.en: The opportunities and challenges will be there in a year, in five years, and in 10 years.
sentences.zh: 一年后、五年后、十年后机遇与挑战并存。

sentences.en: This era is more akin to the Industrial Revolution, when thoughtful people were able to build things that brought substantial value to humanity for two centuries and counting.
sentences.zh: 这个时代更类似于工业革命，当时有思想的人们能够建造出为人类带来两个世纪以来巨大价值的东西。

sentences.en: How does one become a thoughtful person, if you aren't already?
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是一个有思想的人，如何成为一个有思想的人？

sentences.en: Take some time to read novels, study history, learn a language, and travel to a different part of the world.
sentences.zh: 花一些时间阅读小说，研究历史，学习语言，并去世界不同的地方旅行。

sentences.en: Learn to play a musical instrument. Second, remember that it's when people come together that amazing things happen.
sentences.zh: 学习演奏乐器。其次，请记住，只有当人们聚集在一起时，才会发生奇妙的事情。

sentences.en: We tend to overemphasize the accomplishments of so-called geniuses and assign to such geniuses the accomplishments that are really the work of communities.
sentences.zh: 我们倾向于过分强调所谓天才的成就，并将真正属于社区工作的成就分配给这些天才。

sentences.en: As the great postmodern philosopher Taylor Swift once said, I'm just a girl, who's been told she's a genius, but what's a genius if she's all alone? Thank you.
sentences.zh: 正如伟大的后现代哲学家泰勒·斯威夫特（Taylor Swift）曾经说过的那样，我只是一个女孩，有人告诉她她是天才，但如果她孤身一人，那天才又算什么呢？谢谢。
